newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-BOTHAM JUNIOR CHOOSES RUGBY AHEAD OF CRICKET.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-BOTHAM JUNIOR CHOOSES RUGBY AHEAD OF CRICKET.

text.p: Liam Botham, son of former England test captain Ian, turned his back on professional cricket when he signed a three-year contract with English rugby union club West Hartlepool on Friday.
Botham, 19, burst on to the English county scene earlier this year when he collected five for 67 for Hampshire against Middlesex.
"I have enjoyed both cricket and rugby since my school days and perhaps everyone assumed I'd concentrate on cricket," said Botham who plays in the centre.
"While it wasn't an easy decision to make...I've always had a slight preference for rugby."
